<script>
"use strict";

const COLORS = { green:"#2e7d32", red:"#c62828", orange:"#ef6c00" };
// distinct colors per pick location (origin marker + its lines)
const PICK_COLORS = {
  "JONESTOWN":"#283593", "GOODYEAR":"#00838f", "DEKALB":"#6a1b9a",
  "GRAND PRAIRIE":"#ad1457", "MCDONOUGH":"#1565c0"
};
function pickColor(key){ return PICK_COLORS[key] || "#37474f"; }

const map = L.map("map", { zoomControl:true }).setView([39.5, -96], 4);
L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
  maxZoom:19, attribution:'&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
}).addTo(map);

const cluster = L.markerClusterGroup({ maxClusterRadius:45, spiderfyOnMaxZoom:true, showCoverageOnHover:false });
const originLines = L.layerGroup();
const routeLines = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const originMarkers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
map.addLayer(cluster);

// ---- state ----
let DATA = null, groups = [], markerRecs = [];
let picks = [], pickByKey = new Map(), pickCounts = {};
let tmsIndex = new Map();
let activePick = "ALL", activeStatus = "ALL", query = "", smallOnly = false, threshold = 16;
let activeRoutes = new Map();
let lastUpdatedAt = null, didInitialFit = false;

function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c])); }
function keyOf(lat,lng){ return lat.toFixed(5)+","+lng.toFixed(5); }
function colorFor(str){ let h=0; for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++) h=(h*31+str.charCodeAt(i))>>>0; return "hsl("+(h%360)+",65%,42%)"; }

function originPinIcon(color){
  const svg =
    '<svg width="34" height="46" viewBox="0 0 34 46" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">'+
    '<path d="M17 0C8 0 0 7 0 16c0 12 17 30 17 30s17-18 17-30C34 7 26 0 17 0z" fill="'+color+'" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/>'+
    '<path d="M17 6l8 6v9h-5v-6h-6v6H9v-9z" fill="#fff"/></svg>';
  return L.divIcon({ className:"pin-wrap", html:svg, iconSize:[34,46], iconAnchor:[17,46], popupAnchor:[0,-40] });
}
function pinIcon(colorKey){
  const c = COLORS[colorKey];
  const svg =
    '<svg width="30" height="42" viewBox="0 0 30 42" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">'+
    '<path d="M15 0C6.7 0 0 6.7 0 15c0 11.25 15 27 15 27s15-15.75 15-27C30 6.7 23.3 0 15 0z" fill="'+c+'" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.5"/>'+
    '<circle cx="15" cy="15" r="5.5" fill="#fff"/></svg>';
  return L.divIcon({ className:"pin-wrap", html:svg, iconSize:[30,42], iconAnchor:[15,42], popupAnchor:[0,-38] });
}

function colorKeyForOrders(list){
  const hasP = list.some(o => o.status==="PLANNED");
  const hasU = list.some(o => o.status==="UNPLANNED");
  if (hasP && hasU) return "orange";
  if (hasP) return "green";
  return "red";
}

// an order is "visible" under the current pick / status / small filters
function orderVisible(o){
  if (activePick !== "ALL" && o.pick !== activePick) return false;
  if (activeStatus !== "ALL" && o.status !== activeStatus) return false;
  if (smallOnly && !(o.palletSpaces!==null && o.palletSpaces < threshold)) return false;
  return true;
}

// ---- ingest ----
function ingest(data){
  DATA = data;
  threshold = (document.getElementById("thresh").value|0) || data.palletThreshold || 16;

  picks = data.picks || [];
  pickByKey = new Map(picks.map(p => [p.key, p]));

  // group orders by exact drop coordinate
  const gmap = new Map();
  for (const o of data.orders){
    const k = keyOf(o.lat,o.lng);
    if (!gmap.has(k)) gmap.set(k, {lat:o.lat, lng:o.lng, key:k, orders:[]});
    gmap.get(k).orders.push(o);
  }
  groups = [...gmap.values()];

  // counts per pick (across all orders)
  pickCounts = { ALL: data.orders.length };
  for (const p of picks) pickCounts[p.key] = 0;
  for (const o of data.orders) if (o.pick && pickCounts[o.pick]!==undefined) pickCounts[o.pick]++;

  // TMS index
  tmsIndex = new Map();
  for (const o of data.orders){
    if (!o.tms) continue;
    if (!tmsIndex.has(o.tms)) tmsIndex.set(o.tms, { locs:new Map(), color:colorFor(o.tms) });
    tmsIndex.get(o.tms).locs.set(keyOf(o.lat,o.lng), {lat:o.lat, lng:o.lng, name:o.name});
  }

  buildTabs();
  buildMarkers();
  applyFilters(!didInitialFit);
  didInitialFit = true;
  redrawActiveRoutes();
  if (typeof renderLoads === "function") renderLoads();
}

function buildTabs(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById("picktabs");
  wrap.innerHTML = "";
  const tabs = [{key:"ALL", name:"All"}].concat(picks.map(p => ({key:p.key, name:p.name.split(",")[0]})));
  for (const t of tabs){
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.className = "ptab" + (t.key===activePick ? " active":"");
    const col = t.key==="ALL" ? "#334155" : pickColor(t.key);
    if (t.key===activePick) btn.style.background = col;
    const cnt = pickCounts[t.key]!==undefined ? pickCounts[t.key] : 0;
    btn.innerHTML = (t.key==="ALL" ? "" : '<span class="pdot" style="background:'+col+'"></span>') +
                    esc(t.name) + ' <span class="pcount">'+cnt+'</span>';
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => { activePick = t.key; buildTabs(); applyFilters(true); });
    wrap.appendChild(btn);
  }
}

function buildMarkers(){
  markerRecs = groups.map(g => {
    const marker = L.marker([g.lat,g.lng], { icon:pinIcon(colorKeyForOrders(g.orders)) });
    marker.bindPopup(() => popupHtml(g), { maxWidth:340, minWidth:300, autoPanPadding:[40,40] });
    const searchText = g.orders.map(o =>
      [o.name, o.zip, o.tms||"", o.pick||"", ...o.fields.filter(f=>/reference/i.test(f[0])).map(f=>f[1])].join(" ")
    ).join(" ").toLowerCase();
    return { marker, searchText, latlng:[g.lat,g.lng], group:g };
  });
}

function popupHtml(g){
  const vis = g.orders.filter(orderVisible);
  const list = vis.length ? vis : g.orders;          // fall back to all if filter hid them
  const ck = colorKeyForOrders(list);
  const counts = {};
  list.forEach(o => { if (o.name) counts[o.name]=(counts[o.name]||0)+1; });
  let title="Drop location", best=-1;
  for (const n in counts) if (counts[n]>best){ best=counts[n]; title=n; }
  const zip = (list.find(o=>o.zip)||{}).zip || "";
  const n = list.length;

  let html = '<div class="pop"><div class="pop-head '+ck+'">'+
    '<div class="pop-title">'+esc(title)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="pop-meta">'+(zip?"ZIP "+esc(zip)+" &middot; ":"")+n+" order"+(n>1?"s":"")+"</div></div>";
  html += '<div class="pop-body">';

  const tmsHere = [...new Set(list.filter(o=>o.tms).map(o=>o.tms))];
  if (tmsHere.length){
    html += '<div class="loads-block"><div class="lb-title">Load(s) at this stop</div>';
    tmsHere.forEach(t => {
      const info = tmsIndex.get(t);
      const locCount = info ? info.locs.size : 1;
      const on = activeRoutes.has(t);
      html += '<div class="load-item"><span class="load-id">'+
        '<span class="swab" style="background:'+(info?info.color:"#999")+'"></span>'+esc(t)+'</span>';
      if (locCount > 1){
        html += '<button class="load-route-btn'+(on?" on":"")+'" data-tms="'+esc(t)+'">'+
          (on?"Hide route":"Show route")+' ('+locCount+' stops)</button>';
      } else { html += '<span class="load-single">single stop</span>'; }
      html += '</div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
  }

  list.forEach((o,i) => {
    const small = (o.palletSpaces!==null && o.palletSpaces < threshold);
    const badge = o.status==="PLANNED" ? "green" : (o.status==="UNPLANNED" ? "red" : "");
    const pickName = o.pick && pickByKey.get(o.pick) ? pickByKey.get(o.pick).name : o.pick;
    html += '<div class="order-card"><div class="order-no">Order '+(i+1)+" of "+n;
    if (o.status) html += '<span class="badge '+badge+'">'+esc(o.status)+'</span>';
    if (small) html += '<span class="badge small">SMALL &lt;'+threshold+'</span>';
    if (pickName) html += '<span class="badge pick">'+esc(pickName)+'</span>';
    html += '</div><table class="kv">';
    o.fields.forEach(([label,value]) => {
      if (value==="" || value==null) return;
      html += '<tr><td class="k">'+esc(label)+'</td><td class="v">'+esc(value)+'</td></tr>';
    });
    if (o.tms) html += '<tr><td class="k">Load (TMS)</td><td class="v">'+esc(o.tms)+'</td></tr>';
    html += '</table></div>';
  });

  html += '</div></div>';
  return html;
}

// ---- filtering / rendering ----
function applyFilters(fit){
  cluster.clearLayers();
  const layers=[], pts=[];
  let shownOrders=0, planned=0, unplanned=0;
  const originsToShow = new Set();

  for (const m of markerRecs){
    const vis = m.group.orders.filter(orderVisible);
    const okQuery = !query || m.searchText.indexOf(query)>=0;
    if (vis.length && okQuery){
      m.marker.setIcon(pinIcon(colorKeyForOrders(vis)));
      layers.push(m.marker); pts.push(m.latlng);
      shownOrders += vis.length;
      planned += vis.filter(o=>o.status==="PLANNED").length;
      unplanned += vis.filter(o=>o.status==="UNPLANNED").length;
      vis.forEach(o => { if (o.pick) originsToShow.add(o.pick); });
    }
  }
  cluster.addLayers(layers);

  document.getElementById("s-orders").textContent = shownOrders.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById("s-locs").textContent = layers.length.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById("s-planned").textContent = planned.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById("s-unplanned").textContent = unplanned.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById("result-count").textContent =
    layers.length+" of "+markerRecs.length+" drop locations" + (activePick!=="ALL"?" · "+(pickByKey.get(activePick)||{}).name:"");

  drawOriginMarkers(originsToShow);
  if (originLines._map) drawOriginLines();

  if (fit){
    const b = L.latLngBounds(pts.length ? pts : [[39.5,-96]]);
    originsToShow.forEach(k => { const p=pickByKey.get(k); if(p) b.extend([p.lat,p.lng]); });
    if (b.isValid()) map.fitBounds(b, { padding:[55,55], maxZoom:11, animate:false });
  }
}

function drawOriginMarkers(keys){
  originMarkers.clearLayers();
  const show = (activePick==="ALL") ? keys : new Set([activePick]);
  show.forEach(k => {
    const p = pickByKey.get(k); if (!p) return;
    const mk = L.marker([p.lat,p.lng], { icon:originPinIcon(pickColor(k)), zIndexOffset:1000 });
    mk.bindPopup('<div class="pop"><div class="pop-head" style="background:'+pickColor(k)+'">'+
      '<div class="pop-title">'+esc(p.name)+'</div><div class="pop-meta">Pick location &middot; ships '+
      (pickCounts[k]||0)+' orders</div></div></div>', {maxWidth:300});
    mk.bindTooltip(p.name, {direction:"top"});
    originMarkers.addLayer(mk);
  });
}

function drawOriginLines(){
  originLines.clearLayers();
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const m of markerRecs){
    const okQuery = !query || m.searchText.indexOf(query)>=0;
    if (!okQuery) continue;
    const vis = m.group.orders.filter(orderVisible);
    const pks = new Set(vis.map(o=>o.pick).filter(Boolean));
    pks.forEach(k => {
      const p = pickByKey.get(k); if (!p) return;
      const id = k+"|"+m.group.key; if (seen.has(id)) return; seen.add(id);
      L.polyline([[p.lat,p.lng], m.latlng], { color:pickColor(k), weight:1.4, opacity:0.5 }).addTo(originLines);
    });
  }
}

// ---- TMS routes ----
function distSq(a,b){ const dx=a[0]-b[0], dy=a[1]-b[1]; return dx*dx+dy*dy; }
function orderStops(stops, start){
  const remaining = stops.slice(), path=[]; let cur=start||stops[0];
  while (remaining.length){
    let bi=0, bd=Infinity;
    for (let i=0;i<remaining.length;i++){ const d=distSq(cur, remaining[i]); if(d<bd){bd=d; bi=i;} }
    cur = remaining.splice(bi,1)[0]; path.push(cur);
  }
  return path;
}
function toggleRoute(tms){ activeRoutes.has(tms) ? removeRoute(tms) : addRoute(tms); renderRouteChips(); }
function addRoute(tms){
  const info = tmsIndex.get(tms);
  if (!info || info.locs.size < 2) return;
  const stops = [...info.locs.values()].map(s => [s.lat, s.lng]);
  // start the route at the pick origin of any order on this load, if known
  let start = stops[0];
  for (const o of (DATA.orders||[])){ if (o.tms===tms && o.pick && pickByKey.get(o.pick)){ const p=pickByKey.get(o.pick); start=[p.lat,p.lng]; break; } }
  const ordered = orderStops(stops, start);
  const line = L.polyline([start, ...ordered], { color:info.color, weight:3.5, opacity:0.9 });
  line.bindTooltip("Load "+tms+" · "+info.locs.size+" stops", {sticky:true});
  const dots = ordered.map(p => L.circleMarker(p, { radius:5, color:"#fff", weight:2, fillColor:info.color, fillOpacity:1 }));
  activeRoutes.set(tms, L.layerGroup([line, ...dots]).addTo(routeLines));
}
function removeRoute(tms){ const l=activeRoutes.get(tms); if(l) routeLines.removeLayer(l); activeRoutes.delete(tms); }
function redrawActiveRoutes(){ const open=[...activeRoutes.keys()]; open.forEach(removeRoute); open.forEach(t=>{ if(tmsIndex.has(t)) addRoute(t); }); renderRouteChips(); }
function renderRouteChips(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById("routes-chips"); wrap.innerHTML="";
  for (const tms of activeRoutes.keys()){
    const info = tmsIndex.get(tms);
    const chip = document.createElement("span"); chip.className="chip";
    chip.innerHTML = '<span class="swab" style="background:'+(info?info.color:"#999")+'"></span>'+esc(tms)+
      ' <button title="Remove" data-rm="'+esc(tms)+'">&times;</button>';
    wrap.appendChild(chip);
  }
  const has = activeRoutes.size>0;
  document.getElementById("routes-empty").style.display = has ? "none":"block";
  document.getElementById("clear-routes").style.display = has ? "inline-block":"none";
  document.querySelectorAll(".load-route-btn").forEach(btn=>{
    const on = activeRoutes.has(btn.dataset.tms);
    btn.classList.toggle("on", on);
    btn.textContent = (on?"Hide route":"Show route")+btn.textContent.replace(/^(Hide route|Show route)/,"");
  });
}

// ---- data fetch / polling ----
async function fetchData(){
  if (window.__EMBEDDED_DATA__) return window.__EMBEDDED_DATA__;   // emailed single-file mode
  try { const r = await fetch("/api/data",{cache:"no-store"}); if(!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+r.status); return await r.json(); }
  catch(e){ return { __error:e.message }; }
}
function showError(msg){ const el=document.getElementById("error-banner"); if(msg){el.textContent=msg; el.style.display="block";} else el.style.display="none"; }
function updateStatusBar(data){ document.getElementById("updated-at").textContent=data.updatedAt||"—"; document.getElementById("stale-banner").style.display=data.stale?"block":"none"; }
function flashUpdated(){ const el=document.getElementById("updated-at"); el.classList.add("flash"); setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove("flash"),1200); }
async function poll(initial){
  const data = await fetchData();
  if (data.__error){ showError("Can't reach the data feed: "+data.__error); return; }
  if (data.error){ showError(data.error); return; }
  showError(null);
  if (data.updatedAt !== lastUpdatedAt){ lastUpdatedAt=data.updatedAt; ingest(data); if(!initial) flashUpdated(); }
  updateStatusBar(data);
}

function start(){
  map.invalidateSize();
  poll(true).then(()=>{
    if (window.__EMBEDDED_DATA__){            // emailed snapshot: no server to poll
      document.getElementById("refresh-now").style.display = "none";
      const ds = document.getElementById("data-status");
      if (ds) ds.firstElementChild.textContent = "Snapshot from " + ((DATA&&DATA.updatedAt)||"");
      return;
    }
    const s=(DATA&&DATA.pollSeconds)?DATA.pollSeconds:45; setInterval(poll, Math.max(10,s)*1000);
  });
}
window.addEventListener("load", start);
requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ if(!DATA) start(); }));
window.addEventListener("resize", ()=>map.invalidateSize());

// ---- controls ----
document.getElementById("search").addEventListener("input", e => { query=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase(); applyFilters(false); });
document.querySelectorAll(".filters button").forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".filters button").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active"); activeStatus=btn.dataset.f; applyFilters(true);
}));
document.getElementById("t-origin-lines").addEventListener("change", e => {
  if (e.target.checked){ originLines.addTo(map); drawOriginLines(); }
  else { originLines.clearLayers(); map.removeLayer(originLines); }
});
document.getElementById("t-small").addEventListener("change", e => { smallOnly=e.target.checked; applyFilters(true); });
document.getElementById("thresh").addEventListener("change", e => { threshold=(e.target.value|0)||16; applyFilters(false); });
document.getElementById("refresh-now").addEventListener("click", () => { lastUpdatedAt=null; poll(false); });
document.getElementById("clear-routes").addEventListener("click", () => { [...activeRoutes.keys()].forEach(removeRoute); renderRouteChips(); });

document.addEventListener("click", e => {
  const rb = e.target.closest(".load-route-btn");
  if (rb && rb.dataset.tms){ toggleRoute(rb.dataset.tms); return; }
  const rm = e.target.closest("[data-rm]");
  if (rm){ removeRoute(rm.dataset.rm); renderRouteChips(); }
});

// ===== Page 2 — Loads by DC (consolidation) =====
function showPage(which){
  ["map","loads","settings"].forEach(p => {
    const el=document.getElementById("page-"+p); if(el) el.style.display = (p===which) ? (p==="map"?"flex":"block") : "none";
    const nv=document.getElementById("nav-"+p); if(nv) nv.classList.toggle("active", p===which);
  });
  if (which==="map") map.invalidateSize();
  if (which==="loads") renderLoads();
  if (which==="settings") renderSettings();
}
document.getElementById("nav-map").addEventListener("click", () => showPage("map"));
document.getElementById("nav-loads").addEventListener("click", () => showPage("loads"));
document.getElementById("nav-settings").addEventListener("click", () => showPage("settings"));
{ const gs=document.getElementById("goto-settings"); if(gs) gs.addEventListener("click", () => showPage("settings")); }
["c-greenonly","c-group"].forEach(id => {
  const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.addEventListener("input", renderLoads);
});
function nz(z){ if(z==null) return ""; const d=String(z).replace(/\D/g,""); return d ? d.slice(0,5).padStart(5,"0") : ""; }
function nameKey(n){ if(!n) return ""; const w=String(n).toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9 ]/g," ").split(/\s+/).filter(x=>x && !/^\d+$/.test(x)); return w.slice(0,2).join(" "); }
function refOf(o){ const f=(o.fields||[]).find(x=>/reference|shipment ref|ref #|reference number/i.test(x[0])); return f ? f[1] : (((o.fields||[])[0]||["",""])[1]); }
function fmtDayISO(iso){ const dn=dayNum(iso); return dn==null ? String(iso||"") : fmtDay(dn); }
function loadList(orders){
  let h='<div class="loadlist">';
  orders.forEach(o => {
    const win = o.planStart ? (o.planStart===o.planEnd ? fmtDayISO(o.planStart) : fmtDayISO(o.planStart)+" &ndash; "+fmtDayISO(o.planEnd)) : "no date";
    h+='<div class="loadrow"><span class="ref">'+esc(refOf(o))+'</span>'+
       (o.status?'<span class="badge2 '+esc(o.status)+'">'+esc(o.status)+'</span>':'')+
       '<span class="sub">'+(o.weight!=null?Math.round(o.weight).toLocaleString()+" lb":"")+
       (o.palletSpaces!=null?" &middot; "+(Math.round(o.palletSpaces*10)/10)+" pallet sp":"")+
       " &middot; deliver "+win+(o.pickDate?" &middot; picks "+fmtDayISO(o.pickDate):"")+'</span></div>';
  });
  return h+'</div>';
}
document.getElementById("loads-body").addEventListener("click", e => {
  const tr=e.target.closest("tr.grp"); if(!tr) return;
  const d=tr.nextElementSibling;
  if(d && d.classList.contains("detail")){ const show=d.style.display==="none"; d.style.display=show?"":"none"; tr.classList.toggle("open", show); }
});

// ----- Settings: truck limits + per-customer delivery windows (saved on this computer; carries over) -----
const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = { maxWeight:43000, maxPallets:30, def:{startAdj:0,endAdj:0,biz:false},
  customers:[{match:"AMAZON",startAdj:0,endAdj:0,biz:false},{match:"MCLANE",startAdj:0,endAdj:0,biz:false}] };
let SETTINGS = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_SETTINGS));
function normSettings(p){
  p=p||{};
  return { maxWeight:(p.maxWeight!=null?p.maxWeight:43000), maxPallets:(p.maxPallets!=null?p.maxPallets:30),
    def:Object.assign({startAdj:0,endAdj:0,biz:false}, p.def||{}),
    customers:Array.isArray(p.customers)?p.customers:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.customers)) };
}
const LOCKED = !!window.__SETTINGS__;   // true when rules were baked into this file
function saveSettings(){ if(LOCKED) return; try{ localStorage.setItem("dm_settings", JSON.stringify(SETTINGS)); }catch(e){} }
function loadSettings(){
  if(LOCKED){ SETTINGS=normSettings(window.__SETTINGS__); return; }       // locked copy: use the baked-in rules
  try{ const s=localStorage.getItem("dm_settings"); if(s){ SETTINGS=normSettings(JSON.parse(s)); return; } }catch(e){}
  SETTINGS=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_SETTINGS)); saveSettings();
}
function ruleForOrDefault(name){
  if(name){ const u=String(name).toUpperCase(); for(const r of SETTINGS.customers){ if(r.match && u.indexOf(String(r.match).toUpperCase())>=0) return r; } }
  return SETTINGS.def;
}
function renderSettings(){
  const sw=document.getElementById("s-weight"); if(!sw) return;
  sw.value=SETTINGS.maxWeight; document.getElementById("s-pallets").value=SETTINGS.maxPallets;
  document.getElementById("s-defstart").value=SETTINGS.def.startAdj; document.getElementById("s-defend").value=SETTINGS.def.endAdj;
  document.getElementById("s-defday").value=SETTINGS.def.biz?"business":"running";
  const c=document.getElementById("cust-rows"); c.innerHTML="";
  SETTINGS.customers.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const row=document.createElement("div"); row.className="win-row";
    row.innerHTML='contains <input class="cu-match" data-i="'+i+'" value="'+esc(r.match||"")+'" placeholder="e.g. AMAZON"> '+
      '<span class="adjg">start <input class="cu-start adj" type="number" data-i="'+i+'" value="'+(r.startAdj||0)+'"></span> '+
      '<span class="adjg">end <input class="cu-end adj" type="number" data-i="'+i+'" value="'+(r.endAdj||0)+'"></span> '+
      '<select class="cu-day" data-i="'+i+'"><option value="running"'+(r.biz?"":" selected")+'>running</option><option value="business"'+(r.biz?" selected":"")+'>business</option></select> days'+
      ' <button class="cu-del" data-i="'+i+'" title="Remove">&times;</button>';
    c.appendChild(row);
  });
}
(function(){
  function updTop(){
    SETTINGS.maxWeight=parseFloat(document.getElementById("s-weight").value)||0;
    SETTINGS.maxPallets=parseFloat(document.getElementById("s-pallets").value)||0;
    SETTINGS.def.startAdj=parseInt(document.getElementById("s-defstart").value)||0;
    SETTINGS.def.endAdj=parseInt(document.getElementById("s-defend").value)||0;
    SETTINGS.def.biz=document.getElementById("s-defday").value==="business";
    saveSettings(); renderLoads();
  }
  ["s-weight","s-pallets","s-defstart","s-defend","s-defday"].forEach(id=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.addEventListener("input", updTop); });
  const cu=document.getElementById("cust-rows");
  if(cu){
    cu.addEventListener("input", e=>{
      const i=+e.target.dataset.i; if(isNaN(i)||!SETTINGS.customers[i]) return; const r=SETTINGS.customers[i];
      if(e.target.classList.contains("cu-match")) r.match=e.target.value;
      else if(e.target.classList.contains("cu-start")) r.startAdj=parseInt(e.target.value)||0;
      else if(e.target.classList.contains("cu-end")) r.endAdj=parseInt(e.target.value)||0;
      else if(e.target.classList.contains("cu-day")) r.biz=e.target.value==="business";
      saveSettings(); renderLoads();
    });
    cu.addEventListener("click", e=>{ const del=e.target.closest(".cu-del"); if(!del) return; SETTINGS.customers.splice(+del.dataset.i,1); saveSettings(); renderSettings(); renderLoads(); });
  }
  const add=document.getElementById("cust-add"); if(add) add.addEventListener("click", ()=>{ SETTINGS.customers.push({match:"",startAdj:0,endAdj:0,biz:false}); saveSettings(); renderSettings(); });
  loadSettings(); renderSettings();

  // "Download a locked copy" — re-saves this map with the current settings baked in.
  function exportLocked(){
    const clone = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);   // work on a copy; live page stays intact
    ["map","loads-body","cust-rows","routes-chips","loads-summary"].forEach(id=>{ const e=clone.querySelector("#"+id); if(e) e.innerHTML=""; });
    let html = "<!DOCTYPE html>\n" + clone.outerHTML;
    html = html.replace(/<script>\s*window\.__SETTINGS__[\s\S]*?<\/script>\s*/g, "");
    html = html.replace("<head>", "<head>\n<script>window.__SETTINGS__="+JSON.stringify(SETTINGS).replace(/<\//g,"<\\/")+";<\/script>");
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html],{type:"text/html"}));
    const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=url; a.download="DeliveryMap (ready to email).html"; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    const m=document.getElementById("lock-msg"); if(m){ m.style.display="inline"; setTimeout(()=>{ m.style.display="none"; }, 5000); }
  }
  const lb=document.getElementById("lock-export"); if(lb) lb.addEventListener("click", exportLocked);
})();

function dayNum(iso){ if(!iso) return null; const p=String(iso).split("-"); if(p.length<3) return null; return Math.round(Date.UTC(+p[0], +p[1]-1, +p[2]) / 86400000); }
function dow(dn){ return new Date(dn*86400000).getUTCDay(); }            // 0=Sun .. 6=Sat
function addDays(dn, n, business){
  if(!business) return dn + (n||0);
  let d=dn, left=Math.abs(n||0), step=(n||0)>=0?1:-1;
  while(left>0){ d+=step; const w=dow(d); if(w!==0 && w!==6) left--; }
  return d;
}
function fmtDay(dn){ const d=new Date(dn*86400000); return ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"][d.getUTCMonth()]+" "+d.getUTCDate(); }
function fmtRange(a,b){ return a===b ? fmtDay(a) : fmtDay(a)+" – "+fmtDay(b); }

function analyzeGroup(orders, maxW, maxP){
  let name="", best=-1; const counts={};
  orders.forEach(o => { if(o.name){ counts[o.name]=(counts[o.name]||0)+1; if(counts[o.name]>best){best=counts[o.name]; name=o.name;} } });
  const zip=(orders.find(o=>o.zip)||{}).zip||"";
  const weight=orders.reduce((a,o)=>a+(o.weight||0),0);
  const pallets=orders.reduce((a,o)=>a+(o.palletSpaces||0),0);
  let lo=-Infinity, hi=Infinity, have=0;
  orders.forEach(o => {
    const ps=dayNum(o.planStart), pe=dayNum(o.planEnd); if(ps==null||pe==null) return; have++;
    const r=ruleForOrDefault(o.name);                                 // standard or per-customer window
    let ws=addDays(ps, r.startAdj||0, r.biz), we=addDays(pe, r.endAdj||0, r.biz);
    const pk=dayNum(o.pickDate); if(pk!=null) ws=Math.max(ws,pk);     // can't ship before pick date
    lo=Math.max(lo,ws); hi=Math.min(hi,we);
  });
  const overlap = have>0 ? (lo<=hi) : null;
  const fits = weight<maxW && pallets<maxP;
  const multi = orders.length>=2;
  const green = multi && overlap!==false && fits;
  const fill = Math.round(100 * Math.max(maxW!==Infinity?weight/maxW:0, maxP!==Infinity?pallets/maxP:0));
  let windowText = have>0 ? (overlap ? "ship "+fmtRange(lo,hi) : "no common day") : "(no dates)";
  let statusText, st="no";
  if(!multi) statusText="single load";
  else if(overlap===false) statusText="✗ windows don't overlap";
  else if(!fits){ const ov=[]; if(weight>=maxW)ov.push("weight"); if(pallets>=maxP)ov.push("pallets"); statusText="✗ over "+ov.join(" & "); }
  else { statusText="✓ can combine"; st="yes"; }
  return { name:name||"(unnamed)", zip:zip, n:orders.length, weight:weight, pallets:pallets, green:green, fill:fill, windowText:windowText, statusText:statusText, st:st, orders:orders };
}

function renderLoads(){
  const body=document.getElementById("loads-body"); if(!body) return;
  if(!DATA || !DATA.orders){ body.innerHTML=""; return; }
  const maxW=SETTINGS.maxWeight>0 ? SETTINGS.maxWeight : Infinity;
  const maxP=SETTINGS.maxPallets>0 ? SETTINGS.maxPallets : Infinity;
  const greenOnly=document.getElementById("c-greenonly").checked;
  const grp=document.getElementById("c-group").value;

  function destKey(o){
    const z=nz(o.zip), loc=o.lat.toFixed(5)+","+o.lng.toFixed(5);
    if(grp==="loc") return "L:"+loc;
    if(grp==="zip") return z ? "Z:"+z : "L:"+loc;
    return z ? "ZN:"+z+"|"+nameKey(o.name) : "L:"+loc;   // ZIP + customer
  }
  const byDC={};
  DATA.orders.forEach(o => { const dc=o.pick||"__none"; const k=destKey(o);
    (byDC[dc]=byDC[dc]||{}); (byDC[dc][k]=byDC[dc][k]||[]).push(o); });
  const order=(DATA.picks||[]).map(p=>p.key); Object.keys(byDC).forEach(k=>{ if(order.indexOf(k)<0) order.push(k); });

  let html="", totalGreen=0, totalGreenLoads=0;
  order.forEach(dc => {
    if(!byDC[dc]) return;
    let groups=Object.keys(byDC[dc]).map(lk=>analyzeGroup(byDC[dc][lk], maxW, maxP));
    groups.sort((a,b)=> (b.green-a.green) || (b.n-a.n) || (b.weight-a.weight));
    const greenCount=groups.filter(g=>g.green).length;
    totalGreen+=greenCount; groups.forEach(g=>{ if(g.green) totalGreenLoads+=g.n; });
    const shown=greenOnly ? groups.filter(g=>g.green) : groups;
    if(!shown.length) return;
    const dcName = dc==="__none" ? "No DC / unmatched" : ((pickByKey.get(dc)||{}).name || dc);
    html+='<div class="dc-sec"><div class="dc-head">'+esc(dcName)+
      ' <span class="dc-sub">'+groups.length+' destinations &middot; '+greenCount+' combinable</span></div>'+
      '<table class="lt"><thead><tr><th>Destination</th><th>ZIP</th><th class="num">Loads</th>'+
      '<th class="num">Weight (lb)</th><th class="num">Pallet Spaces</th><th class="num">Truck %</th><th>Delivery window</th><th>Ship together?</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    shown.forEach(g => {
      html+='<tr class="grp '+(g.green?"green":"")+'"><td><span class="caret">&#9656;</span>'+esc(g.name)+'</td><td>'+esc(g.zip)+'</td>'+
        '<td class="num">'+g.n+'</td><td class="num">'+Math.round(g.weight).toLocaleString()+'</td>'+
        '<td class="num">'+(Math.round(g.pallets*10)/10).toLocaleString()+'</td>'+
        '<td class="num">'+g.fill+'%</td>'+
        '<td>'+esc(g.windowText)+'</td><td class="st '+g.st+'">'+esc(g.statusText)+'</td></tr>';
      html+='<tr class="detail" style="display:none"><td colspan="8">'+loadList(g.orders)+'</td></tr>';
    });
    html+="</tbody></table></div>";
  });
  document.getElementById("loads-summary").innerHTML =
    "<b>"+totalGreen+"</b> combinable destination group"+(totalGreen===1?"":"s")+
    " ("+totalGreenLoads+" loads) fit one truck under your current limits." +
    " &nbsp;<span style=\"color:#9aa6b2\">Click any destination row to see the loads in it.</span>";
  body.innerHTML = html || '<div style="color:#647280">No loads to show.</div>';
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
